research_question: Do known-delivered nonzero native probes change hidden commanded-target memory as well as public achieved pose after a missing ACK?
system: ManiSkill PickCube-v1 pd_ee_target_delta_pose scripted native actions, PhysX CPU
simulation_protocol: Identical reset seed and t0/t1 action history; native t2 physically held/applied, actual t3 probe. Audit commanded target before and after t3 without using either getter for online decisions. Record achieved XYZ, target pose, quaternion, official ManiSkill information if available. No learned policy and no rollout task claim.
primary_outcome: Paired within reset/truth absolute commanded-target translation delta after nonzero probe versus zero probe; evaluate both robot strata and retain all worlds.
independent_unit: robot/reset cluster; 2 truth x 3 probe observations are repeated measures
baseline: same initial state and ACK truth zero native probe; nonzero X and Y equal nominal action-space magnitude
claim_boundaries: No proof of beneficial active sensing
No statistical superiority unless reset-cluster analysis passes
stop_conditions: audit-only oracle leaks into action choice
frozen_prior_results: Previously heldout 16 reset clusters zero/X/Y all achieved 32/32 ACK classifications; nonzero benefit zero
